title: A/R Detail: the sort stays while changing date, page and filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The report has open documents at both locations on today's and yesterday's date, with more than 100 lines in at least one bucket.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open documents at both locations.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-30 Kept Sort.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open balance" header once.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Expand the largest bucket.
  4. Scroll down inside it until more lines load.
  5. Open the Customer filter.
  6. Tick {Customer-A}.
  7. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  8. Look at the "Open balance" header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows sort by Open balance, largest first, and the header shows it.
  • Step 2: the report reloads for yesterday and is still sorted by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 3: the bucket opens and shows its rows.
  • Step 4: the new rows are still sorted by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 5: the Customer menu opens.
  • Step 6: only {Customer-A}'s rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 7: only {Location-A} rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 8: "Open balance" is still marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, paging, and changing the customer, vendor or Location filter keep it.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first. The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
